card.$description: Corner radius of the standard card (BR-12). TBD-10: "rounded" has no values; this follows a placeholder, not a brand value.
Outline stroke width of the standard card, and of the dividers between its parts (BR-13). TBD-11: "thick" has no values; this follows a placeholder, not a brand value.

bg.$description: Fill of the standard card: the pure black page (BR-03). The card is separated from the page by its outline, not by a surface color (C-05). It does not read color.surface.card until TBD-06 is resolved.

highlight.$description: The neon highlight of the standard card: its outline is brand pink (BR-01, BR-12). Chosen by the owner in ADR-0018.

divider.$description: Color of the lines between the header, body, and footer of the standard card: brand pink, like the outline (ADR-0018).

fg.$description: Title and body text of the standard card. TBD-04: the body text color is not decided; this follows a placeholder, not a brand value.

fgMuted.$description: Description text of the standard card. TBD-05: the neutral scale is not defined; this follows a placeholder, not a brand value.
